title: Acceptance: category_report
prompt: Contract: category_report(expenses) returns dict category -> total spent, rounded to 2 decimals. Empty list -> {}.

tests.name: aggregates by category
tests.code:
expenses = [
    {"amount": 3.5, "category": "food", "note": ""},
    {"amount": 12, "category": "transport", "note": ""},
    {"amount": 1.5, "category": "food", "note": ""},
]
r = category_report(expenses)
assert r == {"food": 5.0, "transport": 12}, f"got {r}"
assert category_report([]) == {}
tests.hint: accumulate with dict.get, round(v, 2) on the way out.
